subject.title: feat(radar): detect open PRs with overlapping diffs (report-only interference radar)

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt this default-off PR interference radar workflow, state artifact, and dashboard panel as a ClawSweeper-owned lane?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound and well-proven, but it adds durable dashboard/state schema and a new workflow with optional publishing, which requires maintainer product and operations intent beyond code review.

options.title: Adopt default-off radar
options.body: Merge the lane with schedule and publish still gated, then enable those gates only when maintainers are ready to operate the report.

options.title: Narrow to manual artifact first
options.body: Keep the CLI and uploaded artifact but defer state publication and dashboard rendering until maintainers see enough manual-run value.

options.title: Pause the lane
options.body: Leave or close the PR if the observability value is not worth adding another ClawSweeper workflow and public report schema right now.

recommendation.title: Adopt default-off radar
recommendation.body: Merge the lane with schedule and publish still gated, then enable those gates only when maintainers are ready to operate the report.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has recent workflow/toolchain history and is the best observed owner for deciding whether this new operational lane belongs in core.
